definition: Simulates Magnetocaloric Cooling Panels operating for a day.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where magnetocaloric beds monitoring, panel logistics redundancy, or field sources maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Magnetocaloric Cooling Panels Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Magnetocaloric Cooling Panels: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Magnetocaloric Cooling Panels — cooling with magnetic materials.

Phase 1 — Prove (magnetocaloric beds): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (panel logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (field sources): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (efficiency): panel hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and refrigeration-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
